note: Firm-authored paraphrase for periods beginning on or after 1 January 2027. Section references are indicative and must be confirmed by a qualified reviewer against the third edition.

items.text: Statement of financial position presented with required headings
Profit or loss presented for the period
Changes in equity reconciled for the period
Comparative amounts presented for the prior period
Basis of preparation and statement of compliance
Going concern assessment and any material uncertainty disclosed
Revenue recognition policy and revenue by category
Contracts with customers: how performance obligations were identified and when revenue is recognised
Fair value measurement basis and hierarchy for items carried at fair value
Components of cash and cash equivalents
Reconciliation of property, plant and equipment
Related party relationships, transactions and key management compensation
